summary: Keep status declaration, runtime and conflict reads in one SQLite snapshot

replay.detail: This read consistency repair does not change claim projection, replay or recovery admission.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, migrations or schema versions change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated fleet upgrade is required.

compatibility.detail: Status fields, declaration selection and start/stop admission are unchanged. A raw status read now joins one SQLite snapshot so a concurrent serial declaration cannot appear as a false conflict. No new client, peer or harness capability is introduced; mixed-version pairs were not newly exercised.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption or runtime restart requirement is introduced by this bounded read transaction.

manual.detail: No existing-store conversion or manual action is required. Real declaration forks and stale start tokens remain rejected.

recovery.detail: Binary swap-back requires no state conversion or rollback migration; older binaries retain the torn status-read risk.
